enrichment.headline: Accepts a free after-school bike club for newcomer students at Oakland International High School
enrichment.summary: Cycles of Change, an Oakland group, will run a bike club for newcomer students after school. The club builds fitness, safe biking skills and teamwork, and gives students a place to practice English. It runs from November 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026 at no cost to the district, and the board is approving it after it started.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No Cost Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Cycles of Change - Oakland International High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts free Living Jazz music program at La Escuelita Elementary School
enrichment.summary: Living Jazz, an Oakland group, will lead a music program at La Escuelita Elementary School to build creativity, confidence, self-expression, collaboration and empathy. It runs from December 1, 2025 to May 28, 2026 at no cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No Cost Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Living Jazz - La Escuelita Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Pays F3 and Associates up to $148,995 for land surveys at six schools
enrichment.summary: F3 and Associates will do land surveys at six schools, including ground surveys, underground utility location using ground-penetrating radar, boundary checks and a survey after construction. The surveys support soil sampling and environmental assessment projects. The amount includes $13,545 held back for extra services the district may request, and work runs from January 29 to March 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – F3 and Associates, Inc. – Site Improvement Projects at Various School Sites - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Sets up The KDI Group, Inc. as an on-call school construction inspector at no upfront cost
enrichment.summary: This is a master agreement that lets The KDI Group, Inc. provide state-certified Inspector of Record services at district school construction projects. It has a $0 limit because no work is guaranteed; future project assignments will come back to the board separately. It starts January 29, 2026 and ends when all assigned projects are complete.

enrichment.headline: Cuts $630,986.67 from Syserco's CAL Shape building contract after removing plumbing work
enrichment.summary: This change order lowers the contract with Syserco Energy Solutions from $11,720,359.50 to $11,089,372.83 by giving the district a credit for plumbing work that was removed. It also shortens the contract by 27 calendar days. The work covers McClymonds High School, Roosevelt Middle School, Ralph Bunche High School and Gateway to Laney College Campus.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between the Owner and Design Builder - Syserco Energy Solutions, Inc. - CAL Shape Design-Build Facilities Planning and Management Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Extends Asbestos Management Group's demolition contract at Ralph Bunche and Hillside to June 30, 2026
enrichment.summary: This change order gives Asbestos Management Group 181 more calendar days, to June 30, 2026, to finish demolition at the Ralph Bunche and Hillside school sites. The work was paused so another contractor could do priority hazardous waste cleanup after a fire. No added money is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Asbestos Management Group - Ralph Bunche and Hillside School Sites Demolition Projects - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf up to $463,244 to replace the turf at Calvin Simmons Middle School
enrichment.summary: Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf will remove the existing turf and install a new turf system at Calvin Simmons Middle School. The amount includes $42,113 for contingencies. The district is buying through a state contract, the California Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS), instead of running its own bid. Work runs from January 29, 2026 to January 29, 2027.

vendor.name: Shaw Integrated and Turf Solutions, Inc. (dba Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
